goal: bun test fails when the generated role map in plugins/immune-brain/README.md drifts from plugins/immune-brain/skills/registry.yaml, so a Managed run's focused QA catches the drift that only CI's sync-dist-docs --check caught before (observed: 431ad3e changed the registry without the plugin README, repaired by hand in 072d5aa). One README rendering function in scripts/skill-registry.ts serves both scripts/sync-dist-docs.ts and the test (#339). No user-visible change: test and build-script refactor only; scripts/ and tests/ are outside package.json files, so the packaged plugin and its README bytes do not change.

acceptance.assertion: In tests/skill-registry-metadata-contract.test.ts, using renderReadmeWithRoleSection and readSkillRegistry imported from scripts/skill-registry.ts (the test holds no copy of the row or marker rendering): (positive) renderReadmeWithRoleSection(<current plugins/immune-brain/README.md>, readSkillRegistry(<repo root>)) returns the README unchanged byte for byte, which fails when a registry entry changes without the README as in 431ad3e; (negative) the same call with one entry's boundary changed returns text different from the README; (negative) a README source without the GENERATED start marker throws, and a source with the start marker but without the END marker throws.

scripts/sync-dist-docs.ts imports renderReadmeWithRoleSection from scripts/skill-registry.ts and no longer defines its own renderReadme function or END marker constant, and `bun scripts/sync-dist-docs.ts --check` exits 0 on the delivered tree (no README role map drift reported).
